meta.name: bids
meta.description: Use this skill when working with Brain Imaging Data Structure (BIDS) datasets: organizing neuroscience and biomedical data (MRI, EEG, MEG, iEEG, PET, microscopy, NIRS, motion capture, EMG, MR spectroscopy, behavioral), querying BIDS layouts, validating compliance, converting DICOM to BIDS, writing metadata sidecars, or creating BIDS derivatives.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将脑影像数据整理为 BIDS 标准格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在处理神经科学影像数据并需要 BIDS 合规化
copy.tagline_en: Organize neuroscience imaging data into BIDS standard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are processing neuroscience imaging data and need BIDS compliance

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会帮你把神经影像数据整理成符合 BIDS 规范的目录结构、用 PyBIDS 按被试或任务查询文件、校验数据集合规性、编写 JSON sidecar 元数据,并把 DICOM 转成 BIDS。
howto.when: 当你要整理、查询或校验 BIDS 数据集,编写元数据 sidecar,或把 DICOM 转成 BIDS 格式时触发。

say.text: 把这个脑影像文件夹整理成符合 BIDS 规范的目录结构
say.note: 给出目录布局与文件命名建议

say.text: 用 PyBIDS 列出数据集中所有 task-nback 的 bold 文件
校验这个 BIDS 数据集,告诉我哪些地方不合规
say.note: 运行 bids-validator 并列出问题

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude helps you organize neuroscience data into BIDS-compliant folders, query datasets with PyBIDS, validate compliance, write JSON sidecar metadata, and convert DICOM into BIDS.
howto.when_en: Use it when you organize, query, or validate a BIDS dataset, write metadata sidecars, or convert DICOM data into BIDS format.

say_en.text: Organize this brain imaging folder into a BIDS-compliant directory structure
Use PyBIDS to list all task-nback bold files in this dataset
Validate this BIDS dataset and tell me what is non-compliant
